Definition: from G2470 and G5092; of equal value or honor:--like precious.
BiblicalUsage: Like precious is the faith Peter says we share. In 2 Peter 1:1 he writes to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the phrase is the whole of the letter in two words: the faith I hold is the same precious faith the apostles held, and it came through the same righteousness.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
